title: A fabricated air-strike video spreads as current news
mechanism_summary: Fact-check reporting describes an AI-generated video falsely presented as footage of a real attack. Accounts amplified it to exaggerate wartime destruction.
suggested_beats: A dramatic conflict clip appears.
Reposts treat synthetic footage as evidence.
Check independent reporting before sharing.
why_it_works: Vivid footage can feel more conclusive than its unverified origin warrants.

title: A landmark appears to burn in fabricated images
mechanism_summary: Fact-checkers documented false images of a landmark burning during real wildfires. Some of the circulated visuals appeared to use AI.
suggested_beats: A real disaster drives urgent updates.
A fabricated landmark image spreads.
Verify damage through official updates and original reporting.
why_it_works: Real danger makes plausible-looking false imagery especially convincing.

title: A synthetic rescue photo triggers emotional sharing
mechanism_summary: A fact-check describes a fabricated image presented as a child rescued after a hurricane. Its emotional scene circulated as if it documented a real rescue.
suggested_beats: An affecting rescue image appears.
Viewers share it as factual evidence.
Verify the image before amplifying it.
why_it_works: An emotional scene can prompt sharing before source checking.

title: Generated reviews invent customer experience
mechanism_summary: Reporting describes AI tools being used to produce fake online reviews at scale. Fabricated experiences can influence purchases without representing genuine customers.
suggested_beats: A shopper reads detailed praise.
Invented experience appears to establish quality.
Compare independent evidence beyond review fluency.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone choosing a product or service online
why_it_works: Specific-sounding detail can imitate authentic firsthand experience.

title: A campaign publishes generated news that never existed
mechanism_summary: Reporting describes a political campaign promoting fake AI-generated news stories. The apparent outside coverage supplied false credibility to its message.
suggested_beats: A campaign shares supposed news coverage.
The stories lack authentic reporting behind them.
Check the original publisher and article.
why_it_works: The appearance of independent coverage can disguise self-promotion.

title: Fabricated arrest pictures lose their context
mechanism_summary: A fact-check documents AI images depicting a public figure's arrest before such an event had occurred. Reposts omitted the synthetic origin, and some viewers believed them.
suggested_beats: A realistic arrest image circulates.
Reposting strips away its fabricated origin.
Confirm the event through original reporting.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone following a prominent news story
why_it_works: A believable image can seem to confirm an anticipated event.

title: A leader appears to order surrender in a fake video
mechanism_summary: Reporting documents a deepfake falsely showing a national leader ordering surrender. The fabricated message circulated during an active conflict.
suggested_beats: An apparent official address appears.
The video announces a false surrender.
Verify through established official channels.
why_it_works: A recognizable authority figure can make an extraordinary claim seem credible.

title: Synthetic pictures invent a celebrity endorsement
mechanism_summary: Reporting describes fabricated images implying that a celebrity endorsed a political candidate. At the time of the posts, the claimed endorsement had not been made.
suggested_beats: A familiar celebrity appears in campaign imagery.
The image implies an unsupported endorsement.
Check the person's authentic statement.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone influenced by celebrity political support
why_it_works: Borrowed celebrity approval can substitute for verified evidence.
